# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.4.0

This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## New: the mode builder

Make your own modes from menus, right in the game. Open **Custom modes** (the panel right of the main menu) and press **X**.

- **Rules and Enemies**, two tabs (LB and RB, or 1 and 3). Pick the base mode, lives, bombs, bonus bombs, a time limit, the speed, gates and the score, then turn enemies off or swap them for others, including the game's unused enemies (marked untested).
- **Play it straight away.** A saves and plays, and when the run ends, Continue brings you back to the builder to tweak it. B saves and goes back to the list.
- **Name it.** Left and Right roll a name, or with the keyboard, press Enter on the name row and type your own.
- The chips at the bottom show the mode as it stands, with its best. Modes with the same rules share a best, and the builder tells you when yours matches one.
- **Y** on any mode builds on it: modes you made in the builder are edited, and any other is copied, so the original never changes. Builder modes can be deleted from the last row of their Rules tab.

Every mode is still a normal `mode.toml` in `user_data/mods`, so you can share it or edit it by hand. The builder only ever rewrites files it made itself.

## Also new

- **Neater Custom modes list.** Button hints are drawn as key caps, long descriptions wrap, and each mode has more room. **X** makes a new mode, **Y** edits or copies, and **RB** (or 3) opens the mods folder.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.4.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
